body:

author: —ES

title: Ui is not intuitive, but I respect the minimalism.
body: It’s seems to be intuitive, but the app is confusing, can’t rearrange tasks on the red board, no idea what the green board is for? When I change a task on the red board to ‘positive’ it just completes the task, I have no idea what’s going on there, seems you have to undo it, like a backwards task? Something you didn’t do? Doesn’t make sense. The icons at the bottom, cog and all are too small and non explanatory, no labels, on all time data screen the task icons at the bottom are amazingly small, no idea how it got past QA, can’t undo a task complete action if I accidentally press and hold it, gou have to erase all historical data. Pressing and holding implies that I’m going to edit the item, I think to complete a task one must click and confirm, this holding it down is not right imo. Anyway.

title: Sneaky charge and mediocre
body: I strongly suggest not to download this app. They don’t make it clear they are going to charge you, then suddenly 3 days after download a charge comes through. I contacted their support with no response. The app itself is mediocre. One can not control the notifications and they come through at annoying times. Rather use a more mature habit app.

author: Mandzilla

title: Simple but powerful - BEST on the market!
body:
Easy to use, simple charts, quick access to record and see how you are doing. I LOVE THIS APP for its POWERFUL SIMPLICITY. The BEST on the market!!!

JUST ONE ISSUE: 
I need the ability to track more than 12 habits - 12 is just not enough when you want to track monthly tasks as well. I like tracking different things on my life wheel and breaking them down into smaller manageable tasks to track. Categories include fitness, health, social, relationships, business, mindset, creativity etc.. they all need 3-6 trackable insights. 

TO THE DEVELOPERS: 
Pls, pls, pls let us add additional groups of six things to track if we want. 24 in total would be great!! But why limit it?! Thanks!!
author: Lizbanmusic

title: Integration!
body:
Wow, the app integration with Health is terrific. I can live my life and have this fantastic app keeping track behind the scenes. A feature I only imagined when I forgot to log certain habits in the past.

 On the watch the display is elegant and comfortable; also a “Complication”, so one can display it on the watch face. I haven’t even used this app for a complete day and I’m smitten.

Great job! Best money I’ve spent in recent memory.

HIGHLY recommended.
